comment: A frustrating unagreeable person who is very entitled to students' free time. She *mandates* you spend about 20+ hours as a “lab” which is just sweatshop labor for the theater and relates in no way to a student's skill development or learning. You must be familiar with sewing beforehand and do everything right the first time, as ?s are discouraged.

I really enjoyed Introduction to Costume with Heather. She is funny, sweet and cares about her students. I didn't have any experience in sewing previously and I thought she taught in a very understandable way. There was some reading in the beginning of the class and a time consuming final but it was pretty cool to work on.

I took intro to costume for my art credit with Heather. I had never sewed before so was at a disadvantage which wasn't clear at all to me based on the description of the class. It was pretty difficult for me because we had a lot of assignments and her criteria was not clear, the class would have to ask her a ton of questions before knowing.

Heather is a little wild but class was basically an easy A. The grading criteria is clear which meant you could distribute your efforts as you see fit. The effort is much more important than the final result for basically every assignment so if you can BS a good reasoning, youll be fine. Not a lot of sewing besides the beginning and lab hours.

Prof. Hogg is very sweet, funny and caring when you reach out to her. She can seem kind of intimidating at first but she is very down to earth. However, she does have extremely high expectations from students , is not always clear and is a very tough grader. Graded on a few easier sewing projects, and one hefty final mask project.

The class wasnt too bad and you get used to knowing what she expects as you go on (she isnt very clear about it, so if she says she thinks something is okay it doesnt mean you did it right). A lot of work for a gen ed but less than other art classes. Dont take this class if you have no knowledge about theatre/drama or youll be shunned
